attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body. The face must feature green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching closed mouth. Preserve the actual observed hair: strongly receding or bare upper crown, very short dark brown/grey side hair, and real brow hair. Maintain the smooth chin and upper lip with no separate moustache or beard. Keep the dark navy/black open-lapel suit, white shirt, and dark tie with subtle brown/warm shading visible beside the note; do not invent a bright red tie. Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening, ensuring coherent front and rear collar overlap with contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must remain opaque, with alpha transparency only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct as observed.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Bareheaded nearly frontal serious CLOSED-MOUTH bust with actual primary mild head angle. Strongly receding/bare upper crown with very short DARK BROWN/grey side hair and real brow HAIR, smooth chin/upper lip with no separate moustache or beard. Dark navy/black OPEN-lapel suit, WHITE shirt and DARK tie with subtle brown/warm shading visible beside note; do not invent a bright red tie. No cap or spectacles, preserve original fastening and crop/overlap; fine texture indistinct.
Preserve exact source head angle and expression. Whole yellow area above raised/broadened neckline is one compact near-round head, with clearly rounded chin immediately contacting the very short broad collar transition, no additional separate neck shaft or pointed V. Image1 is the exact original small card; Image2 identity only. Fine markings indistinct in Image1 must remain understated, not invented as a readable symbol.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
